Hi Olga —

Thanks for the package, looks great and thorough. A few quick notes from events ops: 

- A/V window: 35 minutes total is fine; please keep the live demo to 12 minutes to allow for a short Q&A.
- Recording: we capture the session and provide a post-event asset (mp4) within 72 hours; captions will be auto-generated. If you need manual captioning, let me know ASAP (extra charge).
- Slide limits: please keep deck under 12 slides. We recommend a 1-slide demo flow and 1 troubleshooting slide for the audience.

We reviewed the failover checklist and added two items (network failover contact + alternate demo video). I've attached a short A/V protocol doc for speakers.

I can accept the final one-pager Wed morning and add it to the registrant email sequence.

See you onboard — and cc'ing events@edgeconf.com for ops details.

Best,
Natalie
Senior Events Manager, EdgeConf
